note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

jsonic.reason: Go: go/feed.go imports github.com/tabnas/jsonic/go and takes from it only names that jsonic's go/engine.go aliases from the engine (the `Feed` plugin's parameter is a `*jsonic.Jsonic`, which is `tabnas.Tabnas`), and go/clib/core.go, the C library, imports it to build the host parser with `host.Make()`. Rust: rs/src/lib.rs calls `tabnas_jsonic::make()` in `make_with`, which `make` and `parse` build on, so the crate hands out a ready feed parser. TypeScript: ts/src/feed.ts has no import of @tabnas/jsonic, value or type, and its only value exports are `VERSION`, `Feed` and `detect`, so it has no parser constructor and the caller writes `new Tabnas().use(jsonic).use(Feed)`, as the tests in ts/test do with jsonic as a devDependency; the peer was removed from ts/package.json on 2026-10-04 (tabnas/feed#71), and jsonic still reaches an install as a required peer of @tabnas/xml.
jsonic.repair: To agree on having it: ts/package.json would list @tabnas/jsonic as a peer again, reversing tabnas/feed#71, although ts/src would still not import it unless it gained a constructor like Rust's `make`. To agree on not having it: go/feed.go would import github.com/tabnas/parser/go for the engine types, go/clib/core.go (stamped from admin's clib template) would need another way to build its host parser, and rs/src/lib.rs would lose `make`, `make_with` and `parse`; jsonic would stay in every port's build regardless, because xml depends on it in all three. The TypeScript peer was removed under ruling 9 of the handover page in tabnas/parser (doc/handover/README.md); nothing there rules on the Go and Rust ports. Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
